title: Gluing normalized sections of the symmetric degree-one twist
statement: For a scheme S and a quasi-coherent module E, the canonical relative symmetric Proj carries a module L, affine chart isomorphisms from its tensor pullbacks to the degree-one twists, and a map sigma from E to the direct image of L. Under each chart, the tensor-pulled section sigma(m) equals the section defined by unitToTwist(iota(m)). This asserts neither invertibility of L nor epimorphy of the adjoint of sigma. The grading, twists and tensor pullbacks are those of [def-trf-canonical-symmetric-graded-algebra], [def-weil-pbc-proj-twisting-sheaf] and [def-pc-module-pullback].

proof.text: Descend the affine twists with compatible additive transition maps. No map from E is included in this object-descent result.

The normalized tensor unit is bijective over the range of an open immersion. Compose it with the chart isomorphism and apply pushforward to obtain a bijective linear chart-reading map on sections over the affine base open U. Invert this linear map and compose with the affine generator map.

Use the transition equations and restriction_ι to prove that the transported linear maps commute with affine restriction. Extend the underlying additive natural transformation from the affine basis using Mathlib restrictHomEquivHom. Check scalar linearity on affine opens inside any open and use sheaf separation. This produces sigma. Its affine evaluation equation and the normalized tensor-unit formula give exactly the required normalization.

proof_origin.place: Tag 01NR: object descent followed by affine-basis gluing of the linear homogeneous-section map; Tag 01OB for iota

theorem exists_symmetric_twist_sections
    (S : Scheme.{u}) (E : S.Modules) [E.IsQuasicoherent] :
    ∃ (L : (SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProj.Modules)
      (chart : ∀ U : S.affineOpens,
      (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback
        ((SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProjι U)).obj L ≅
          Proj.twist ((SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).grading U) 1)
      (σ : E ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward
      (SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProjHom).obj L),
    ∀ (U : S.affineOpens) (m : E.val.obj (op U.1))
      (hm : SymmetricAlgebra.ι Γ(S, U.1) (E.val.obj (op U.1)) m ∈
        (SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).grading U 1),
    (chart U).hom.app
        ((SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProjι U ⁻¹ᵁ
          ((SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProjHom ⁻¹ᵁ U.1))
        (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackSection
          ((SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProjι U) L
          ((SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProjHom ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)
          (σ.app U.1 m)) =
      Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (Proj.unitToTwist
        (𝒜 := (SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).grading U) hm)
        ((SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProjι U ⁻¹ᵁ
          ((SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProjHom ⁻¹ᵁ U.1))
        (1 : Γ(Proj ((SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).grading U),
          (SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProjι U ⁻¹ᵁ
            ((SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProjHom ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)))
